original_value: A hybrid dendritic neural architecture is proposed for robust classification and neural architecture search. The model combines dendritic branches, synaptic weighting, and a multi-objective evolutionary optimizer inspired by cuckoo search and genetic search to improve convergence and reduce sensitivity to initialization. The method is evaluated on benchmark pattern recognition tasks against a multilayer perceptron and a dendritic neuron baseline, with emphasis on accuracy, ROC performance, and search efficiency. The study also explores a compact logical-circuit realization for hardware-friendly deployment.
